focus.name: scene-render-services
focus.purpose: Bound the complete scene-resource service wrappers and palette fade variants adjacent to the established VDP and transition helpers.

targets.name: VDP_PrepareTileRowCommandsStride16
targets.contract: Write the 0x9010 VDP control value, load D1 with 0x40, call VDP_BuildTileRowCommandTables, and return.

targets.name: SceneResource_RunServiceFramesWhileReady
targets.contract: If SCENE_RESOURCE_STATUS is clear, execute D0+1 iterations of Terrain_QueryFlagDispatcher, Frame_RunServicePass, and Frame_WaitForVBlankWork.

targets.name: SceneResource_RunSingleServiceFrame
targets.contract: If SCENE_RESOURCE_STATUS is clear, execute one VBlank/query/frame-service sequence while preserving the full register set.

targets.name: Render_FadePaletteBandToWhite
targets.contract: Snapshot 16 palette words and perform 16 VBlank-paced positive component-step passes at VDP palette address 0xC000.

targets.name: Render_FadePaletteToWhite
targets.contract: Snapshot 64 palette words and perform 16 VBlank-paced positive component-step passes at VDP palette address 0xC000.

relationships: 0x001B2EC2 and 0x001B2EE2 call Terrain_QueryFlagDispatcher, Frame_RunServicePass, and Frame_WaitForVBlankWork according to their respective contracts.

0x001B2F00 and 0x001B2F7E share the component masks 0x000E, 0x00E0, and 0x0E00 with the established palette convergence helpers, but always increment toward maximum component values rather than a caller-supplied palette.
limitations: The current whole-ROM export reports no direct static callers for these formerly unassigned entries; they may be reached through indirect service tables or alternate entry paths.
The higher-level scene-state meaning of the stride wrapper and the palette fade callers remains unresolved.
